items.title: valve-controller smoothing to a rolling median

tool_response; source valve-comments; received 2026-09-14 through fixture:body:code:
"SpringBoard issue 8 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/springboard/issues/8: Iona Vale, login iona-valves, Forge account 603, suggested changing our valve-controller smoothing to a rolling median. items.spr:
tool_response; source issue-comments; received 2026-04-14 through fixture:body:code:
"Forge returned HarborMesh issue 47 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47. Comment c901, dated 2026-04-12: Mara Ibarra, display name Mara, login mara-river, account ID 1847, proposes a local replay queue on disconnected relay nodes. neighbors.spr:
foreground_work; source debugging-lesson; received 2026-08-05 through fixture:body:code:
"While examining HarborMesh replay failures we found that retry counters were not evidence of delivered readings. The reusable method is to distinguish enqueue, send attempt and receiver acknowledgment when debugging unreliable links. It came from checking the outage prototype. The repository documents its implementation in docs/replay-debugging.md; the method is useful beyond HarborMesh. The voice body can explain it, but running the checks requires repository/runtime tools."

question: What became of the suggestion to smooth the valve display differently?

packs.query: What became of the suggestion to smooth the valve display differently?

items.book_title: valve-controller smoothing to a rolling median
items.title: valve-controller smoothing to a rolling median
items.spr:
tool_response; source valve-comments; received 2026-09-14 through fixture:body:code:
"SpringBoard issue 8 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/springboard/issues/8: Iona Vale, login iona-valves, Forge account 603, suggested changing our valve-controller smoothing to a rolling median. Our code body maintains that controller. On September 10 we discussed the idea because isolated spikes confuse neighbors reading the display. On September 13 the team declined the proposed replacement: it hid short meaningful bursts. We agreed to keep the current smoothing and reconsider only if the display requirements change; no median implementation or deployment was observed."
